title: fix(plugin-dashboard,components,plugin-report): read stored date-only days through toDisplayDate (objectui#10844)
body:
Fixes #10844

Clause-②: no
Each date-only read goes through the existing `toDisplayDate`. No declared key, export or accept set moves.

## What changed

This is the closure card for the date-only zone family. Three read sites parsed a stored date-only `YYYY-MM-DD` string with the engine's own `Date` parse, which reads it as UTC midnight. So every viewer west of UTC saw the day before. Each site now reads the string through `toDisplayDate` (`@object-ui/core`, the objectui#10183 convention). Each site also has a zone pin registered in the `PINS` list of the objectui#10183 driver, `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`. The driver runs each pin in a forks child under `America/Los_Angeles` (west) and `Asia/Shanghai` (the control). Each zone opens with a rig case, so a child whose zone did not move turns red.

| Site | Before, west of UTC | After |
|---|---|---|
| plugin-dashboard `DashboardFilterBar`, `rangeFrom` / `rangeTo` | Clicking 15 Sep commits `2026-09-15`, then the calendar highlights the 14th. A range from 1 Oct opens on September | Highlights the 15th. Opens on October |
| components `date-picker` renderer, an ISO string `value` | `2024-01-15` is labelled "January 14th, 2024" and the calendar selects the 14th | "January 15th, 2024". The calendar selects and opens on the 15th |
| plugin-report `formatValue`, the report cell's date face (found by the census) | `2026-09-15` reads `2026-09-14` | Reads `2026-09-15` |

The file surface: the claim names the first two sites and "any further date-only read site the census finds". The third site, `packages/plugin-report/src/formatValue.ts`, is one of those. `ReportViewer` uses this face for an untyped ISO-looking value and for an aggregated column, such as a `max` over a date.

### The date-picker's read, and what an unparseable string does now

The decision is made at the renderer's read, in `toPickerDay`, before `format`, `selected` and `defaultMonth`. Only a date-only string that names a real day goes through `toDisplayDate`. `isRealCalendarDate` from `@object-ui/core` makes that judgement. A `Date`, a date-time string and any other string reach date-fns unchanged.

Measured with date-fns directly, in node under `TZ=UTC` and `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`:
- `format('not a date', 'PPP')` throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` in both zones. After this change the trigger still throws on such a value, exactly as before, because the value passes through untouched.
- `2024-02-30` rolls to `March 1st, 2024` in UTC and `February 29th, 2024` in LA. It still reaches the engine rather than being refused. Refusing it would hand `format` an Invalid Date and make the trigger throw where it rendered before. The pin asserts that it renders. That rolled face is recorded below and not changed here.

### Refusals that moved (the objectui#10026 ruling, on the shared step)

`toDisplayDate` refuses a day that its month does not have.
- Dashboard range: a bound of `2026-02-30` used to roll into March. It now selects no day. A refused `from` opens the calendar on today, as an unparseable `from` already did. A valid `from` next to a refused `to` renders without throwing. All of this is pinned in the suite zone.
- Report cell: such a value renders as the raw stored string. That is the cell's existing face for an unparseable value.

## Pins and ablation

The new pins are:
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardFilterBar.dateOnlyZone-10844.test.tsx`: west click round-trip, a range from 1 Oct, the east control, and the suite-zone refusal cases.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/date-picker.dateValueZone-10844.test.tsx`: label, selected day and opening month for a `Date`, a date-only string and an instant, west and east.
- `packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/formatValue.dateOnlyZone-10844.test.ts`: typed and sniffed, west and east.

Each fix was committed first and then mutated with `ablation-replace.mjs`, which asserts that the anchor hit once and that the blob changed. The restore was proven with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. In the vitest root config the pins resolve `@object-ui/*` to `src` through `resolve.alias`, so no `dist` is involved.
1. `DashboardFilterBar`: both `toDisplayDate(value.from/to)` calls were changed back to `new Date(...)`. The driver went red on this pin only: 2 failed, 6 passed. The failing cases were the west click case (`selected: ['2026-09-14']`) and the 1 Oct case. The rig, fixture and east cases and the other pins stayed green, and the child exited 1. The blob was restored to `716dea90092f`.
2. `date-picker`: `const day = toPickerDay(value);` was changed to `const day = value;`. The west date-only case failed (`label: 'January 14th, 2024'`). The instant case and the east control stayed green. Restored to `f896cd9b9a0a`.
3. `formatValue`: `toDisplayDate(value)` was changed to `new Date(value)`. The west case failed (`'2026-09-14'`). The instant case and the east control stayed green. Restored to `90b2aebb6231`.

## Acceptance notes

### The census

Method, at base `4aebea0`: `git grep -n "new Date("` over non-test, non-story `packages/**/*.ts(x)` gave 348 lines, 262 of them with an argument. I also searched for `Date.parse(` and for the date-fns imports (`format`, `parseISO`, `toDate`). Each hit is below with its disposition.

**Fixed here.** The three sites above.

**Already reads through `toDisplayDate` or follows its convention:**
- core: `utils/date-display.ts` (the step itself); `native-date-value.ts`, where `toDateInputValue` passes a leading `YYYY-MM-DD` through verbatim.
- fields: the `index.tsx` date cell (its `title` keeps the engine instant on purpose, documented in place); `DateField`; `FormulaField`; `GridField` (its datetime arm keeps the instant); `lookupColumnDisplay` (`$date` goes to `formatDate`).
- plugin-detail `DetailView`; app-shell `auditHistoryDisplay`.
- components: `calendar.tsx`; `data-table` (through `formatDate`).
- Through `formatDate`: plugin-grid `ObjectGrid`, plugin-dashboard `recordFields`, and the plugin-gantt `ObjectGantt` tooltip.

**Not date-only: audit, system and event instants.**
- app-shell: ConversationsSidebar, CloudConnectionPanel, InstalledListWidget, MarketplacePage, MarketplacePackagePage, AcceptInvitationPage, InvitationsPage, MembersPage, ActivityFeed, AiUsageIndicator, relativeTime, RecordApprovalsPanel, AuditPanel, ResourceHistoryPage, StudioHomePage, ExternalDatasourcePanel, FlowRunsPanel, JobPreview, CommitTimeline, RecordDetailView.
- plugin-detail: ActivityTimeline, ConcurrentUpdateDialog, HistoryTimeline, RecordActivityTimeline, RecordComments, RecordMetaFooter, ThreadedReplies, record-history, recordActivityFeed.
- Others: auth AuthProvider; collaboration CommentThread; components DebugPanel and ShareDialog; core SharingProtocol (a validity check only); plugin-ai NLQueryInput; plugin-chatbot AiPendingActionsInbox; plugin-designer VersionHistory; plugin-form occSave; plugin-grid ImportWizard (the job time); types http-retry.

**Not a parse of a stored value:**
- Date arithmetic, copies and multi-argument constructors: core date-macros, the CalendarView grid, GanttView, scheduling, shifts, ResourceWorkload, and the timeline renderer's interpolation.
- The expression engine's `Date` constructor, in `SafeExpressionParser`.
- Demo and sample data: `plugin-gantt/demo`, and the sample events in calendar-view-renderer.
- Comments.

**Validity checks and orderings, not a face:**
- `Date.parse` validity guards: dashboard-filters, dataset-format, ImportWizard, importParsers, the ObjectGrid sniff, the activity feeds.
- The validation engine's min/max comparison, where both sides parse the same way.
- Timestamp sorts.

**Same class, not fixed here.** Each of these shows a stored date-only day as the day before, west of UTC. This is read from the code and not measured in a browser.
1. **plugin-calendar.** The reads are the ObjectCalendar event `start` / `end` (`new Date(startDate)`), the calendar-view-renderer `schema.data` events, and the authored `currentDate` (`resolveAuthoredCurrentDate`). CalendarView's `getEventsForDate` then places a date-only event on the previous day's cell. This is not small. ObjectCalendar writes a moved or quick-created event back as `toISOString()` of that `Date`, so a local-midnight read changes the instant it writes: east of UTC the ISO string names the previous day. The write path has to be decided together with the read.
2. **plugin-gantt.** The reads are the ObjectGantt task `start` / `end` and baselines, and the GanttView `startDate` / `endDate` / `markers`. This is not small: GanttView's `tzShift` re-bases every `Date` into a configured zone, and the drag write-back is `toISOString()`.
3. **plugin-timeline.** ObjectTimeline's `dateBucket` reads `startOfDay(new Date(raw))`, so west of UTC an item dated today lands in the Overdue bucket. The renderer's `formatDate` reads local getters for its short and long faces but uses `toISOString()` for its default face, and the axis extent is a third read. This is not small: three reads across two files must agree, and fixing one alone leaves the timeline contradicting itself.
4. **plugin-charts.** AdvancedChartImpl's `formatTick` reads a category of `2026-09-01` as `Aug 31` / `Aug 2026` west of UTC. This is not small: a pin needs a rendered recharts axis. Also, its fallback prints `toISOString()`, which would name the previous day east of UTC once the parse is local.
5. **core FormulaFunctions.** DATEADD, DATEDIFF and DATEFORMAT parse with `new Date(dateStr)` and read local getters, while TODAY() and DATEADD's result are UTC `toISOString()`. This is not small: routing only the parse would make DATEADD's UTC output name the previous day east of UTC. The formula date functions need one zone decision.
6. **i18n.** The published helpers `formatDate`, `formatDateTime`, `formatRelativeTime` and `formatDateSpec` accept a string. There is no caller in the repo (only the README), so these are recorded only.

**Adjacent, outside this card's read class:**
- The plugin-detail InlineFieldInput date editor WRITES `new Date(v + 'T00:00:00').toISOString()` for a `date` field. That is local midnight as a UTC instant, whose date part is the previous day east of UTC. It is a write, not a read.
- The date-picker's `2024-02-30` still rolls forward (see above). That belongs to the objectui#10026 class, not to the zone class.
- The custom-range select's reopen defect is objectui#10843, which is serial after this card. The select is not touched here.

## Verification, at `a6757a2`

- **Type-check.** I first built the 13-package dependency closure (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-report^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' run build`, exit 0). Then `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard --filter @object-ui/plugin-report type-check` exited 0; each package echoes `type-check$ tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and prints Done. Each `tsconfig.test.json` includes the `src/**/*.test.ts(x)` glob. `pnpm type-check:scripts` exited 0.
- **Driver and pins.** `pnpm exec vitest run` on the driver plus the three pins: 4 files, 15 passed, 20 skipped. The 20 skipped are the zone cases, which run only in the driver's forks child, where every case must pass.
- **Package suites, at `bf2d6eb`.** The only later commit adds one case to the dashboard pin, and that pin ran at `a6757a2`.
  - `packages/plugin-dashboard/` and `packages/plugin-report/`: 167 files, 1549 passed, 13 skipped.
  - `packages/components/`, run in two halves: 138 files (1312 passed) and 184 files (183 passed, 1 whole-file skip that already existed; 1825 tests passed).
- **Gates, each exit 0 at `a6757a2`.**
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `-no-major`, `-claims`, `-fixed` and `-overwrite`.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
  - `check:new-line-citations`, which prints `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, and `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`.
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps` and `check:unreferenced-sources`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the changed paths answers "An ordinary pull request".
- **ESLint, narrowed.** The repo-wide run belongs to CI. I ran the root `eslint.config.js` with `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 7 changed code files: 0 errors and 22 warnings. The warnings are identical per file to base: date-picker 1, DashboardFilterBar 18, formatValue 3, driver 0. The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

Changeset: `.changeset/10844-date-only-zone-closure.md`, a `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-report`.
